home.title: Source from verified Chinese manufacturers, with confidence.
home.subtitle: CargoScope connects Kenyan wholesale buyers with vetted factories — transparent landed costs, in-app translation, and trust built in at every step.

pillars.verifiedBody: Every manufacturer is document-checked and tier-rated before they can list, so you know who you are buying from.
pillars.landedBody: See the real price in KES — product, freight, duty, and fees — before you commit, with no surprises at the port.
pillars.translateBody: Message factories in English or Swahili and we translate to Mandarin instantly, so nothing gets lost.
